abilities.description: Abilities are non-magical special actions that use Stamina (short rest resource) or have limited uses. Unlike spells, abilities don't require spellcasting ability and can be used by any calling.

dedication.name: Steady Nerve
dedication.description: You have a well of inner resolve to draw upon. As a bonus action, choose one of the following options: Heal (regain 1d8 + your Dedication level + CON modifier HP), Attack (make one weapon attack), Dash (double movement this turn), Disengage (movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks), or Dodge (attackers have disadvantage until start of your next turn).

options.name: Heal
options.description: Regain 1d8 + Dedication level + CON modifier hit points

options.name: Attack
options.description: Make one weapon attack as part of this bonus action

options.name: Dash
options.description: Double your movement speed for this turn (not yet implemented)

options.name: Disengage
options.description: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks this turn (not yet implemented)

options.name: Dodge
options.description: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have disadvantage

dedication.name: Action Surge
dedication.description: You can push yourself beyond normal limits. On your turn, take one additional action. At 17th level, you can use this twice per rest.

dedication.name: Indomitable
dedication.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail. You must use the new roll. You can use this feature twice at 13th level and three times at 17th level.

dedication.name: Flurry of Blows
dedication.description: Immediately after taking the Attack action, spend 1 stamina to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

dedication.name: Patient Defense
dedication.description: Spend 1 stamina to take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

wanderlust.name: Cunning Action
wanderlust.description: You can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

wanderlust.name: Sneak Attack
wanderlust.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage to a creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage or an ally is within 5 feet of the target. Must use finesse or ranged weapon.

wanderlust.name: Uncanny Dodge
wanderlust.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, use your reaction to halve the attack's damage.

wanderlust.name: Bardic Inspiration
wanderlust.description: Grant an ally an inspiration die (d6) they can add to an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw within 10 minutes. Die size increases at higher levels.

bond.name: Hunter's Mark
bond.description: Mark a creature you can see. Deal an extra 1d6 damage when you hit it with a weapon attack. Lasts 1 hour or until the target drops to 0 HP. You can transfer the mark to a new creature as a bonus action.

bond.name: Primal Strike
bond.description: Your connection to nature empowers your strikes. When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an additional 1d8 damage. The damage type is your choice of cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

bond.name: Wild Shape
bond.description: Transform into a beast you've seen with CR 1/4 or lower. Lasts for a number of hours equal to half your level (minimum 1). You gain the beast's HP, AC, and physical abilities.

oath.name: Lay on Hands
oath.description: You have a pool of healing power (5 × your level) that replenishes on a long rest. As an action, touch a creature to restore HP from this pool. You can also spend 5 HP to cure one disease or poison.

oath.name: Divine Smite
oath.description: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, expend a spell slot to deal extra radiant damage: 2d8 for 1st level, plus 1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8). Add 1d8 against undead/fiends.

oath.name: Crimson Rite
oath.description: Imbue a weapon with hemocraft magic. Take damage equal to one hit die as the weapon ignites with crimson energy. The weapon deals an extra 1d4 damage (fire, cold, lightning, or necrotic) while active. Lasts until short/long rest.

instinct.name: Rage
instinct.description: Enter a rage for 1 minute. Gain advantage on STR checks/saves, +2 melee damage, and resistance to physical damage. Can't cast spells while raging. Ends early if you don't attack or take damage on a turn.

instinct.name: Reckless Attack
instinct.description: When you make your first attack on your turn, gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls this turn. Attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

instinct.name: Quickened Spell (Metamagic)
instinct.description: Spend 2 sorcery points to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action.

instinct.name: Empowered Spell (Metamagic)
instinct.description: Spend 1 sorcery point when rolling damage for a spell to reroll up to your CHA modifier of the damage dice. You must use the new rolls.

scholar.name: Arcane Recovery
scholar.description: During a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your level (rounded up). No slot can be 6th level or higher.

scholar.name: Flash of Genius
scholar.description: When you or an ally within 30 feet makes an ability check or saving throw, use your reaction to add your INT modifier to the roll.

scholar.name: Infuse Item
scholar.description: Imbue mundane items with magic. You know 4 infusion recipes and can have 2 active at a time. Active infusions last until your next long rest.

pact.name: Eldritch Blast
pact.description: A beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack: 1d10 force damage. Gain additional beams at 5th (2 beams), 11th (3 beams), and 17th (4 beams) level.

pact.name: Eldritch Invocations
pact.description: Learn fragments of forbidden knowledge (invocations) that grant ongoing benefits. Choose 2 invocations at 2nd level.

pact.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
pact.description: Present your holy symbol to force undead within 30 feet to make a WIS save. On failure, they are turned for 1 minute or until damaged.

pact.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
pact.description: Restore hit points equal to 5 × your level, divided among creatures within 30 feet. Can't restore above half their max HP.
